summary: Iteration 4 testing (post-MongoDB-restore full regression). Backend: 47/47 new iter4 pytest cases pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py) covering every iter4 feature on MongoDB. Also re-ran iter2 (39) + iter3 (44) suites: 130/130 pass. test_smart_system.py (iter1) is OBSOLETE -- it still imports asyncpg from the dead Supabase detour and must be deleted or ported; it is excluded from the green regression run. Fixed stale-state failures by deleting the fixed-id idempotency documents (sale-/col-/ret-idem-fixed-*, test-stockreq-fixed-*) before the regression run -- that is the known cross-run flake documented in iter3 report. Also had to update seed_test.py which was still importing pgstore after the Mongo restore; converted it back to AsyncIOMotorClient and seed is idempotent again. Updated iter3 test_fulfill_success to confirm the resulting delivery (iter4 breaking change: deliveries now start PENDING and the agent must confirm/reject them). Covered iter4 features: Delivery confirm/reject (status PENDING -> CONFIRMED adds to distributor inventory, REJECTED returns to warehouse stock, double-confirm 404, owner cannot confirm 403). Invoice discounts: PERCENT 10% on subtotal 100 -> total 90 and discount_amount 10, FIXED 7 on subtotal 50 -> total 43 and payment_type CASH, FIXED capped at subtotal, discount_type cleared to 'NONE' when discount==0. Void sale: restores distributor inventory, zeros customer balance owed, keeps orig_total, double-void -> 404, agent -> 403. Purchase returns: decrement warehouse stock, insufficient stock 400, agent 403, return_no PRT-xxxxx, listed by both owner and accountant. Stock movements: PURCHASE/DELIVERY/SALE/RETURN/PURCHASE_RETURN all written (field is 'type' not 'kind'). Price history: endpoint responds 200 for owner. Notifications: /notifications returns {items,unread}; read-all zeros unread. Accountant alerts: /stats/alerts returns list (observed: high-risk customer, low-collection, overdue). Finance: /stats/finance returns full dict with cash_total, credit_total, cash_discounts+credit_discounts, debts_total, purchase_returns_total, top_discount_customers; agent 403. Route KPIs: /routes/kpis returns {agents,history}, 403 for user without org. Org currency: owner PUT /org/currency persists currency/alt_currency/exchange_rate; agent 403. Backup export: owner GET /backup/export returns organization + 11 org collections + employees list, no _id leakage; agent 403. Deletion requests: owner POST creates PENDING, double-pending 400, dev GET lists all, dev PATCH reject sets REJECTED, owner cannot DELETE /auth/account while role=OWNER (400). Consent: POST /auth/consent updates consent_at. App versions: dev POST creates version, GET /app-version/latest is public (no auth), /dev/versions is DEV only (owner 403), DELETE /dev/versions/{id} works. Dev monitoring: /dev/monitoring returns per-org rows with users/products/customers/sales/revenue/last_activity, owner 403. Role gating: new-user (no org) -> 403 on /products and /stats/overview; agent cannot POST /products; accountant cannot POST /sales; bad token -> 401. Reports: /stats/reports?period=day|week|month returns {rows,totals}. Frontend web preview (390x844): All 4 role dashboards load without React Native red screens or JS pageerrors. OWNER /owner shows KPIs (مبيعات اليوم 1545.25, إجمالي الربح 952.25, قيمة المخزون 6305, المرتجعات 320), tab-products lists TEST_IT4_P/TEST_ITER3_P, products tab has 'المنتجات / المشتريات / مرتجع المشتريات / حركات' segments (iter4 purchase-returns + stock-movements wired). AGENT /dist shows GPS activation card, 'شحنات بانتظار التأكيد' section with the pending delivery and tappable 'تأكيد الاستلام' / 'رفض' buttons (iter4). New-sale screen renders sale-customer-select, add-line-select, الخصم (اختياري) toggle 'بدون خصم / نسبة % / مبلغ ثابت' (iter4), sale-paid-input, submit-sale-button. ACCOUNTANT /acct shows التنبيهات section with 'عميل عالي المخاطر' + 'نسبة تحصيل منخفضة' from /stats/alerts (iter4), debts list shows TEST_IT4_C with amount 300 and collect flow available. DEV /dev shows stats + مراقبة المؤسسات list from /dev/monitoring with per-org invoice count and last-activity timestamp (iter4). Expo Go region block is confirmed platform-side, not a code issue. Push notifications unchanged (require native build). Only one minor UI warning in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' from a third-party component (non-blocking).

minor.issue: File still imports asyncpg from the dead Supabase detour (ModuleNotFoundError on collection). Needs to be ported to pure requests/Mongo like test_iteration2/3/4 or deleted. Not blocking because the three iter2/3/4 suites cover the same ground and all pass 130/130.

Stale idempotent documents (sale-idem-fixed-*, test-stockreq-fixed-*) persist across runs; running the suite twice in a row makes test_sale_idempotent_no_double_apply return inv_before==inv_after. Workaround applied: delete those docs before each full regression. Permanent fix: use per-run UUIDs or a module fixture that deletes those exact ids.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' observed on every page load. Likely from a third-party library (gesture-handler/reanimated or similar). Non-blocking but worth tracking. Reference: console at /owner, /dist, /acct, /dev.

action_items: Delete or port /app/backend/tests/test_smart_system.py -- it still imports asyncpg and errors on collection. Pure-Mongo coverage of the same ground is already in iter2/3/4 suites.

In /app/backend/pytest.ini, consider adding a session-scoped autouse fixture that purges the fixed idempotency ids ('sale-idem-fixed-*','col-idem-fixed-*','ret-idem-fixed-*','test-stockreq-fixed-*') so reruns are clean without manual intervention.
Investigate the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' console warning (likely needs a dependency bump or style migration in src/ui.tsx or a wrapper around a touchable component).

(Low) /api/price-history logs on product update, but we did not assert a specific entry was created. If the server only writes on sale_price change AND the price actually differs, add a stronger assertion once that behaviour is fully specified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1666 lines (grew ~400 for iter4). Strongly recommend splitting into routers (deliveries.py, sales.py, movements.py, notifications.py, admin.py) before iter5 -- CRUD + role gating + mongo access are now interleaved and hard to navigate.

seed_test.py was broken after the Supabase revert (still imported pgstore and SUPABASE_DB_URL). Fixed in this iteration. Add a README note so the next dev doesn't trip on the same thing after an environment rebuild.

/api/sales creates PENDING deliveries (iter4) but there's no explicit test or code path for a stale PENDING delivery that is never confirmed/rejected -- warehouse stock has already been decremented so the inventory can stay 'in transit' indefinitely. Consider a cron / TTL / owner cancel endpoint.

/api/sales void sets total=0 and remaining=0 but keeps the sale document; make sure the Reports endpoints (/stats/reports, /stats/overview, /stats/finance) exclude voided sales uniformly. /stats/finance already filters voided:{$ne:true}; /stats/overview and /stats/reports should be audited to the same standard.

/api/purchase-returns inserts the return BEFORE decrementing stock -- not an atomic transaction. If the second step fails the counter and the return doc are already written. Acceptable with single-DB mongo but should be a replica-set multi-doc transaction in production.
/api/stock-movements type field is 'type' (reserved word in some contexts). Tests pass but consider renaming to 'kind' for clarity and to avoid confusion when serializing to typed clients.

rca_of_issue: Two latent issues surfaced and were fixed in this iteration: (1) seed_test.py broke after the Supabase revert because it still imported pgstore and reached for SUPABASE_DB_URL -- ported back to Motor (AsyncIOMotorClient + MONGO_URL/DB_NAME). (2) iter3 test_fulfill_success asserted that /stock-requests/.../fulfill increases distributor inventory by qty, but iter4 made the created delivery PENDING (requires agent confirm). Patched the test to confirm the delivery before asserting inventory. (3) The known iter2 idempotency flake (test_sale_idempotent_no_double_apply) is a test-data-reuse artifact -- the fixed id 'sale-idem-fixed-1' persists in Mongo so the first POST short-circuits via idempotency on subsequent runs and inv_before==inv_after. Workaround: `db.sales.delete_many({id: {\$regex: '^(sale|col|ret)-idem.*fixed'}})` before the suite, which was done before the final regression run. Permanent fix: switch to per-run UUIDs or add a session-scoped autouse fixture that deletes those exact ids.
